p: it came to pass: Christ shows by his works that he is the promised Messiah.
commanding his twelve disciples: Of instructing them with precepts.
their cities: The disciples' cities, that is to say, in Galilee, where many of them were born; Ac 2:7.
And as they departed: The similarity and the difference between the ministry of the prophets, the preaching of John, and the full light, of the gospel, which Christ has brought.

kingdom of heaven is greater than: In the new state of the Church where the true glory of God shines: the people are not compared together, but the types of doctrines, the preaching of John with the law and the prophets: and again, the most clear preaching of the gospel is compared with John's.
prophesied until John: They prophesied of things to come, which are now present, and clearly and plainly seen.
But whereunto shall I liken this: There are none who are more stout and stubborn enemies of the gospel, than they to whom it ought to be most acceptable.
It is like unto children sitting: He blames the perverseness of this age, by a proverb, in that they could be moved neither with rough nor gentle dealing.
But: That which the many refuse, the elect and chosen embrace.
wisdom is justified of her children: Wise men acknowledge the wisdom of the gospel when they receive it.
Then began he to upbraid the: The proud reject the gospel offered to them (to their great hurt and pain) which leads to the salvation of the simple.
revealed them unto babes: Through the ministry of Christ, who alone shows the truth of all things pertaining to God.
Even so: This word shows that he contents himself in his Father's council.
good in thy sight: God's will is the only rule of righteousness.
All things are delivered unto me: There is no true knowledge of God, nor quietness of mind, but only in Christ alone.
easy: May easily be carried. For his commandments are not grievous, for all who are born of God overcome the world; 1Jo 5:4.
